  • mkdocs serve - Start the live-reloading docs server.
  • mkdocs build - Build the documentation site.
  • mkdocs -h - Print help message and exit.

docs.title: API Documentation
docs.text: This page contains the complete OpenAPI specification for the Mico Generative AI API.

docs.title: Generative AI API 1.0.0
docs.text: Comprehensive AI Vision API for image processing and generation using ComfyICU, Flux, and OpenAI platforms.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Background Removal: Automatically remove backgrounds from images
  • Object Extraction: Extract objects using bounding boxes or point selection
  • Human Generation: Generate photorealistic human images from text prompts with detailed control options
  • Stock Photo Generation: Generate stock photo style images with enhanced prompts and detailed control options
  • Image Outpainting: Extend images beyond their original boundaries
  • Image Inpainting: Fill in missing or damaged parts of images
  • Inpainting Removal: Remove objects from images using AI inpainting
  • Ad Variation: Generate ad variations with manual prompts or automatic analysis mode
  • Image Variations Recommendation: Get AI-powered recommendations for image variations

docs.title: Authentication
docs.text: All /aivision/* endpoints require authentication using one of the following methods:

docs.title: Bearer Token Authentication
docs.text:
Use your API key with Bearer format: 

Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY

Note: /health and /documentation endpoints are publicly accessible and do not require authentication.

docs.title: File Upload Limits
docs.text:
• Maximum file size: 35MB
  • Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP
  • Maximum files per request: 10

docs.title: Services
docs.text:
• Mico (ComfyICU): Primary AI service for most operations
  • Flux: Alternative service for inpainting and outpainting
  • OpenAI: Advanced service for inpainting and outpainting

docs.title: Rate Limits
docs.text:
• Standard rate limiting applies
  • GPU accelerator options: low, medium, high

docs.title: Prompt Formats
docs.text: The API supports two prompt formats for generation endpoints:

docs.title: String Format (Simple)
docs.text:
{
  "prompt": "A beautiful woman in a garden"
}

docs.title: JSON Format (Advanced)
docs.text:
{
  "prompt": {
    "text": "A beautiful woman in a garden",
    "category": "illustration",
    "style": "realistic photography",
    "background": "natural garden setting",
    "mood": "peaceful"
  }
}

docs.title: JSON Format (Metadata Only)
docs.text:
{
  "prompt": {
    "text": "",
    "category": "illustration",
    "style": "Japanese Manga pop style",
    "background": "urban cityscape",
    "mood": "peaceful"
  }
}

The JSON format allows for detailed control over image generation by combining multiple properties into a single, well-formatted prompt. The text property is optional and can be empty, allowing for metadata-only prompts.

Contact: Mico GenAI services API Support l.deron@mico-inc.com License: ISC

docs.title: POST /aivision/objectsExtraction
docs.text:
Extract objects from image

Description

Extract objects from an image using either bounding boxes or point selection. Supports both object extraction (with bounding boxes) and object segmentation (with points).

Input parameters

Parameter In Type Default Nullable Description BearerAuth header string N/A No Bearer token authentication. Supports two formats: 1. Bearer with API key: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`

Request body

multipart/form-data 
{
    "file": "scene.jpg",
    "bboxes": "[{\"startX\": 100, \"startY\": 150, \"endX\": 300, \"endY\": 400}, {\"startX\": 500, \"startY\": 200, \"endX\": 700, \"endY\": 450}]"
}

{
    "file": "portrait.jpg",
    "bboxes": "[{\"startX\": 50, \"startY\": 50, \"endX\": 250, \"endY\": 350}]"
}

{
    "file": "complex_scene.jpg",
    "points": "{\"positive\": [{\"x\": 150, \"y\": 200}, {\"x\": 160, \"y\": 210}], \"negative\": [{\"x\": 0, \"y\": 0}, {\"x\": 800, \"y\": 600}]}"
}
Schema of the request body 
{
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
        "file": {
            "type": "string",
            "format": "binary",
            "description": "Image file to process (JPEG, PNG, WebP, max 35MB)"
        },
        "bboxes": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "JSON array of bounding boxes for object extraction.\nFormat: [{\"startX\": 0, \"startY\": 0, \"endX\": 100, \"endY\": 100}]\n"
        },
        "points": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "JSON object with positive and negative points for segmentation.\nFormat: {\"positive\": [{\"x\": 100, \"y\": 100}], \"negative\": [{\"x\": 0, \"y\": 0}]}\n"
        }
    },
    "required": [
        "file"
    ],
    "oneOf": [

docs.text:
Generate human images

Description

Generate photorealistic human images from text prompts using AI.

Input parameters

Parameter In Type Default Nullable Description BearerAuth header string N/A No Bearer token authentication. Supports two formats: 1. Bearer with API key: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`

Request body

application/json 
{
    "prompt": {
        "text": "A young Japanese female in the building on a sunny day",
        "category": "illustration",
        "style": "Japanese Manga pop style",
        "background": "urban cityscape",
        "mood": "peaceful"
    },
    "width": 1024,
    "height": 1024,
    "batchSize": 2,
    "accelerator": "medium"
}

docs.title: POST /aivision/imageInpaintingRemoval
docs.text:
Remove objects using inpainting

Description

Remove objects from an image using AI inpainting techniques. Supports Mico (ComfyICU), Flux, and OpenAI services. For Flux and OpenAI services, only the original image and prompt are required. For Mico service, both original image and mask are required.

Input parameters

Parameter In Type Default Nullable Description BearerAuth header string N/A No Bearer token authentication. Supports two formats: 1. Bearer with API key: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`
